rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2013 as 'Sympa de Bellevue'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Large, very double, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Named after a famous Percheron horse.
